items.title: FedEx Stock And Other Fuel Cost Winners If Oil Prices Stay Low
items.summary: Oil benchmarks have been sliding while major forecasters talk about a supply surplus stretching into the next few years, and that mix puts energy hungry businesses in an unusual spotlight. Cheaper crude can quietly reshape cost bases and profit potential, and investors who ignore that shift risk missing it. This article picks out three stocks from our Global Oil Importing, Energy Intensive Sectors screener that appear well placed if fuel stays less of a burden. The three stocks highlighted...

items.title: FedEx Was Down to Its Last $5,000 When Its Founder, a Marine Who Served Two Tours in Vietnam, Flew to Las Vegas and Sat Down at a Blackjack Table. He Came Back With $27,000, and the Planes Kept Flying
items.summary: FedEx was down to about $5,000 when Fred Smith flew to Las Vegas and won $27,000 at blackjack. He called it an omen. The real save was the $11 million he raised next.
